kcnh2a.why: longfin t2 is a cis-regulatory kcnh2a allele (PMID 34061172); kcnh2a is one of the two convergent loci in flying fishes (PMID 34534441)

slc43a2b_LAT4.why: full-length zebrafish L-type amino acid transporter 4; the flying-fish paper names 'lat4a' (PMID 34534441) and the syngnathid screen names lat4a (PMID 40689752)
slc43a2b_LAT4.name_mapping_confidence: medium: gene-symbol correspondence between the papers' lat4a and UniProt slc43a2a/slc43a2b is unresolved here

slc43a2a_fragment.why: the UniProt entry carrying the slc43a2a symbol; 153 aa, a fragment, kept only to test whether a distinct locus is detectable
slc43a2a_fragment.name_mapping_confidence: low: fragment entry, not a full-length protein

rcan2.why: retinoic acid -> rcan2 -> Kcnk5b chain scaling the pectoral fin bud (PMID 38527087)

cacna1g.why: cacna1g mutants regenerate extraordinarily long fins (PMID 41321290)

gja1_cx43_sof.why: short fin (sof) is cx43; sets fin-ray segment length (UniProt entry names shf/sof)

hhip.why: anterior-posterior constraint on Hedgehog signalling in fin elaboration (PMID 39417578)

shhb_twhh.why: second hedgehog paralog; caudal fin shape is re-patterned by Shh signalling (PMID 40853969)

and2.why: and1/and2 double mutants lack actinotrichia and lose ray patterning (PMID 41885168, 42741580); and1 was mapped in round 1

msxb.why: round-1 query; re-included because the Ensembl coordinate lookup for msxb failed (HTTP 400) in the bioservices harvest
